name: Financial Model
description: Convert mechanism-map and driver-map output into operating models, DCF, comps, reverse DCF, valuation bridge, or update maps for existing Excel workbooks.
author: buy-side-research-system

trigger.description: 当用户要搭新模型、做 DCF/comps/reverse DCF、或根据财报更新已有 Excel model 时触发；只拆 driver 时用 driver-map

capabilities.output_path: topics/[topic_type]/[topic-slug]/model.xlsx or user-provided workbook when user asks
requirements: use mechanism-map for engineering mechanism, equipment-chain, and know-how gaps
use driver-map for revenue, margin, backlog, and price-volume-mix assumptions
preserve existing workbook structure when updating
do not force a standard template
produce an update map before editing existing workbooks
connect valuation assumptions back to drivers
do not invent undisclosed revenue drivers
